description: Take back a request you sent, while it is still pending. Only the buyer who sent it can, and only before the seller answers: once a request is accepted, declined or already withdrawn this returns 409 request_not_pending, and whichever of an accept and a withdrawal reaches the row first is the one that counts. A withdrawal that succeeds charges you nothing and releases any reservation the request was holding against your spending limit. A 409 saying the seller accepted first means the request went through and your card was charged, so read the outcome before assuming the money stayed put. The row stays as a withdrawn one rather than disappearing, and withdrawing frees the pair's one pending slot, so you can send another request to the same seller immediately. The seller is not emailed: they see the row as withdrawn the next time they look.
name: withdraw_request
title: Withdraw a request you sent
